name: Wizard
desc: Wizards are defined by their exhaustive study of magic.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.desc: You can regain some of your magical energy by studying your spellbook.

features.name: Scholar
features.desc: While studying magic, you also specialized in another field of study.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.desc: Your damaging cantrips affect even creatures that avoid the brunt of the effect.
